message.text: Checking helpers.go to locate the AppendConditions function that converts filter expressions into SQL.
Checking whether `validateFilter` uses the same engine as the ListMemos RPC filter.

The filter syntax is CEL (Common Expression Language). It is documented in proto files and implemented with cel-go.

The engine lives in `internal/filter/engine.go`. Dialect drivers call `filter.DefaultEngine()` and `AppendConditions()`, which compile each filter string via `Engine.CompileToStatement()`. That yields a condition tree rendered into SQL by `render.go` using dialect-specific `RenderOptions`.
